§6Structure Tower§f is the invisible scaffolding that tells Advanced Rocketry multiblocks where they begin and end. Every AR machine uses these on its corners to define the bounding box.

Craft 8 at a time with 8 Steel Sticks in the pattern 'xxx / x / xxx' (the hollow 3x3 minus center). In survival, Structure Towers appear automatically when you assemble a valid multiblock, so you usually only craft them when planning layouts.

§cWARNING:§f Breaking a Structure Tower while a multiblock is active will dismantle the entire machine. Use F3 + B to see hitboxes if the towers are invisible in your render mode.

§ePS:§f Most AR multiblocks are 3x3x3 hollow cubes with Structure Towers on the 8 corners.
